title: Bucknell @ Pitt: a 52.5-point spread
sub: Saturday · Acrisure Stadium, Pittsburgh · PITT -52.5 · total 63.5 (DraftKings)
body: The biggest spread on this week's board: a Patriot League FCS program visiting an ACC team. At 52.5 points, the market is asking Pitt to win by more than seven touchdowns and change.
fact: Since 2010 there have been 100 college games with a spread of 50+ points. The favorite covered only 42% of the time, but the underdog was shut out in 30% of them. The biggest this season: Miami -59.5 vs Florida A&M (Miami won 77–7).
model: Model take: fair line PITT -52.3, fair total 63.7. The Over 63.5 is also on this week's Blowout Overs list.
